reason: The hypothesis applies the phonon drag mechanism, previously reported for the Co-containing Cantor alloy (P2), to a Co-free FeNiCrMn variant and predicts an amplified effect due to a modified phonon spectrum, but it provides no evidence or reasoning for how Co removal alters the phonon spectrum or why this would enhance drag, making the core idea a minor compositional tweak of a known result.
